market_question: Will Czechia win the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
reasoning: Czechia is a mid-tier UEFA team, ranked ~45th globally, and hasn't qualified for a World Cup since 2006. Their actual chance to win the 2026 tournament is realistically around 0.1%, given the strength of the field and the difficulty of even qualifying. The market implies ~0.3%, overpricing YES by about 2x.
evidence_points: Failed to qualify for the 2018 and 2022 World Cups.
Similar long-shot national teams typically have implied odds of 0.1–0.2% in betting markets.
Even if they qualify, the path to the title against global powers is extremely unlikely.
sources_consulted: Typical betting-market odds for comparable teams
